quote.name: Matthew Kunze (Security Researcher and FOSS Advocate)
quote.text: I was hoping to see a beautiful explosion of FOSS for iOS after the Digital Markets Act was passed, but that didn't happen due to Apple's malicious compliance. "Sideloaded" apps still have to be manually reviewed by a human at Apple before they are approved ("notarized"), with no opt out, and absurd fees make alternative app stores an unattractive option in general. I fully support your initiative to compel Apple to properly comply with the DMA.
